scope: Substantive refresh of an existing post at its URL, adding sources

observations.summary: Kitchen grease is a leading cause of residential sewer line blockages; flushed solids and tree roots also cause clogs; property owner maintains the lateral to the main line connection; have a plumber clear the lateral mechanically at least every 2 years; learn the location of lines and cleanouts; call 911 if sewage flows to the street or a storm drain.
observations.inference_limit: County sanitation guidance; applies to county sewer service areas.

observations.summary: Lateral is the property owner's responsibility; lateral should have an accessible cleanout, usually in or near the sidewalk; owner liable for spills from a malfunctioning private lateral; fine for repeat spills.

Replaced an unsourced 18 to 22 month cleaning interval with the county's at least every 2 years. Removed a fast-dissolving toilet paper claim, 'experienced technicians' and 'trusted' claims, a templated FAQ and a broken nested list. Retitled to the question the URL answers and corrected hero alt text to the photo (tree roots pulled from a sewer line). Added what to do, responsibility, prevention, septic note, FAQ and sources. Original date kept, updated set to 2026-10-26.
